cd /workspace/tmp/tests && cat > stress2.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, random, resource, sys, time, io
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
import driver
rng=random.Random(3)
NS=16
names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(NS)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
policies=[]
for k in range(16):
    ws=set()
    while len(ws)<250: ws.add(tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(6)))
    policies.append(' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in ws))
events=[{'op':'stage','epoch':k+1,'policy':policies[k]} for k in range(16)]
events.append({'op':'commit','epoch':16})
for i in range(1,200): events.append({'op':'spawn','unit':[0,i,1],'service':names[i%NS]})
while len(events)<200000: events.append({'op':'inspect'})
j={'services':reg,'limits':LIM,'events':events}
data=json.dumps({'jobs':[j]},separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('input bytes', len(data), 'events', len(events))

t=time.time(); req=driver.decode(data); t_decode=time.time()-t
t=time.time(); v=driver.validate(req[0]); t_val=time.time()-t
print('decode %.2fs validate %.2fs'%(t_decode,t_val))

# full run, discard output
class Null:
    def write(self,b): pass
t=time.time()
w=driver.Writer(Null(), chunk=1<<20)
driver.run(data,w); w.flush()
print('full run %.2fs'%(time.time()-t))
print('peak rss MiB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)

# real write to a buffer to measure output volume + write cost
t=time.time()
buf=io.BytesIO()
w=driver.Writer(buf, chunk=1<<20)
driver.run(data,w); w.flush()
print('run+buffer %.2fs outbytes %d'%(time.time()-t, buf.tell()))
print('peak rss MiB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
PYEOF
time python3 stress2.py
